title: Grade 4 Science — Mon, May 18
description: Food & Nutrition — Day 1 of 5: Types of food and nutrients
subject: science

questions.question: Which nutrient gives us energy?
questions.explanation: Carbohydrates (rice, bread, potatoes) are the main energy source. They are the body's fuel!

questions.question: Which nutrient helps build muscles and repair the body?
questions.explanation: Proteins (eggs, pulses, meat, milk) build and repair body tissues, including muscles.

questions.question: Which vitamin prevents night blindness?
questions.explanation: Vitamin A (found in carrots, papaya, green vegetables) keeps eyes healthy and prevents night blindness.

questions.question: Which nutrient helps the body absorb calcium for strong bones?
questions.explanation: Vitamin D (from sunlight and eggs) helps absorb calcium, keeping bones and teeth strong.

questions.question: Fats store ___ in the body.
questions.explanation: Fats store energy for later use. Oils, butter, nuts, and seeds are fat-rich foods.

questions.question: Which is the best source of carbohydrates?
questions.explanation: Rice, wheat, potatoes, and bread are excellent carbohydrate sources — staple foods in India.

questions.question: Vitamin C is found in citrus fruits. What does it do?
options: Helps heal wounds and boosts immunity
questions.explanation: Vitamin C (in oranges, lemons, amla) boosts immunity and helps wounds heal. Deficiency causes scurvy.

questions.question: Which of these is a protein-rich food?
questions.explanation: Lentils (dal) are excellent protein sources. Other protein foods: eggs, paneer, meat, fish, soya.

questions.question: Why is water essential for the body?
options: It digests food, regulates temperature, carries nutrients, removes waste
It is only needed when sick
questions.explanation: Water is involved in digestion, blood circulation, temperature control, and removing waste. We need 6–8 glasses daily.

questions.question: Minerals like iron and calcium help:
options: Build bones, make blood, control body processes
questions.explanation: Iron makes hemoglobin (carries oxygen in blood). Calcium makes bones and teeth strong. Iodine controls metabolism.

questions.question: Which disease is caused by lack of Vitamin C?
questions.explanation: Scurvy is caused by Vitamin C deficiency — symptoms include bleeding gums and weak immunity.

questions.question: Which disease is caused by lack of Vitamin D?
questions.explanation: Rickets is caused by Vitamin D deficiency — leads to soft, weak, bowed bones in children.

questions.question: A 'balanced diet' means:
options: Eating all nutrients in right proportions
questions.explanation: A balanced diet includes carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, and water in the right amounts.

questions.question: Which nutrient does NOT give energy but is essential?
questions.explanation: Vitamins do not directly provide energy but are essential for regulating body processes, immunity, and growth.

questions.question: Roughage (dietary fibre) helps:
questions.explanation: Roughage (fibre from vegetables, fruits, whole grains) keeps the digestive system healthy and prevents constipation.
